notes.title: Calyx Demo v0.0.3.3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed reduced range on high ground
Fixed some cases where plant units got stuck
Fixes to key bindings
Fixed missing materials in DX11
Updated balancing for Inferno Tank
Fix for Artillery Turret being buildable before the Hub finished deploying
Fix for saves containing an edge case where a Calyx root might not die off correctly
Mitigation for a random crash - may not be 100% effective as it's difficult to repro reliably right now

notes.title: Patch notes 0.0.3.2
notes.content:
Balance tweaks
Made calyx roots harder at level start
Move ore field on The Gauntlet
Slow down key repeat on building rotate key
Fix crash when giving cover orders to harvesters
Plant units no longer show "firing" toggle
Fixed issue where plants were not treated as dead in skirmish

notes.title: Calyx Demo v0.0.3.1 - patch notes
notes.content:
Fix for save game not storing map settings correctly
Fixed an issue where you had no starting resources if you restarted the tutorial
Skip the narrative intro when the tutorial is restarted
Fix plus and minus buttons for Ore reserve stealing focus from the keyboard
